description: Post a new message to a neighborhood bulletin board. Prerequisite: caller must be a resident (fso_roommates row on a lot in target neighborhood) and not have moved in 7 days (unless admin: moderation_level > 0 bypasses the move penalty). Also gated by post-frequency: community posts at most once per Bulletin_Post_Frequency (default 3 days). Effect: fso_bulletin_posts row INSERT with type='community' (or 'mayor' if caller is the current mayor). Returns the created bulletin_id. Refuse paths: SEND_FAIL_NON_RESIDENT, SEND_FAIL_JUST_MOVED, SEND_FAIL_TOO_FREQUENT, SEND_FAIL_INVALID_TITLE (>64 chars), SEND_FAIL_INVALID_MESSAGE (>1000 chars), SEND_FAIL_GAMEPLAY_BAN. Wire: BulletinRequest{Type=POST_MESSAGE, TargetNHood, Title, Message, LotID=0} on city Aries; resolves on the next BulletinResponse (SEND_SUCCESS returns the BulletinItem).
